svg.text: Weather glyphs — each code shown day (white) / night (shaded)

g.title: 57 — Dense freezing drizzle (left: day, right: night)
67 — Heavy freezing rain (left: day, right: night)
68 — Rain and snow (left: day, right: night)
69 — Heavy rain and snow (left: day, right: night)
86 — Heavy snow showers (left: day, right: night)
96 — Thunderstorm with hail (left: day, right: night)
99 — Thunderstorm with heavy hail (left: day, right: night)
